title: Oathbringer
summary: Dalinar opens the Honor's Perpendicularity in Thaylen City. He discovers his past as the Bondsmith, the warrior who killed his wife under the influence of Odium. The Everstorm ravages Roshar.
archivistNote: The Everstorm represents a fundamental change to Rosharan investiture. Unlike the highstorms that preceded it, which were part of Honor’s original design, the Everstorm was created by Odium. Its long-term effects on Roshar’s ecology and investiture systems are still being studied.
